drafts.title: Early
drafts.pitch: Null knocks on the stop door from inside and explains itself, exactly as pitched, ending on a wordless knock.
drafts.reason: Clean and faithful, but it ends on a wordless knock with no Tilde button, so it lands softer than the published strips.

drafts.title: Early (Tilde's knock)
drafts.pitch: Same beats, but the last knock is Tilde's: it slumps over to the door and leans into it once, and Null says thanks.
drafts.reason: Tilde, who barely moves, joining the knock and getting a quiet 'Thanks' is a warm character turn, though the payoff is gentle rather than sharp.
